proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2095 distinguishes undura with u-vowel rat/mouse forms from section 2 indūra, explicitly represented by Bengali ĩdur and Assamese endur. The survey vowel identifies the selected branch; the ultimate Austroasiatic etymology remains Turner’s attribution. Exact survey form udur is preserved.
